scope: Make the pinned Publish 14.1 equipped-weapon skill calculation authoritative wherever restored PRE-CU combat consumes a player level, without exposing or reintroducing an NGE combat-level progression system.

findings: Publish 14.1 calculates a player's internal combat level from private_<equipped weapon type>_combat_difficulty divided by 100 plus one, capped at 25.
A Jedi wielding a lightsaber adds private_jedi_difficulty before the cap; a missing weapon produces level zero.
Publish 14.1 state application subtracts five from that internal player level while creature targets retain their authored creature level.
The internal value is combat math only: it is not an NGE visible combat level, item requirement, profession template, or retained-content difficulty score.
